content.text: Pack Maya's bag for school: book1, book2, bottle1, laptop1, lunchbox1, notebook1, notebook2, pencilcase1. Heavy items at the bottom. Laptop in the front slot. Bottle upright and away from the laptop. lunchbox1 last. Leave mug and plate.

docs.keywords: left arm L reach table_left table_center
docs.text: Arm L reaches table_left and table_center and the bag.

docs.keywords: right arm R reach table_right table_center
docs.text: Arm R reaches table_right and table_center and the bag.
Eyes report objects with class, region, size, and estimated mass and fragility. Objects in a blind region may be missing; ask for another LOOK.
Lessons from past episodes are appended below by the monitor.
Books are heavy and robust; they go at the bottom.
Water bottles are about 0.9 kg and can leak if laid flat.
Laptops are heavy (about 1.8 kg) and moderately fragile. Grip gently.
Lunchboxes are light to medium and fragile to crushing.

docs.keywords: bag opening exclusive lock one arm at a time
docs.text: Only one arm may place into the bag at a time. Serialize place tasks with dependencies.

docs.keywords: bottle water upright away laptop leak
docs.text: Water bottles go in upright and in a different compartment from the laptop. Use orientation=upright.

docs.keywords: heavy bottom stack order weight mass main compartment
docs.text: Place heavier items first so they sit at the bottom of the main compartment; lighter items go on top. Sort items by estimated mass, descending.
The laptop goes in the compartment named by the instruction (default: the padded laptop slot). Never stack other items on or beside it in the same compartment.

docs.keywords: leave distractor mug plate untouched not pack
docs.text: Items the instruction says to leave (for example the mug and the plate) must not be touched, moved or pushed aside.
The lunchbox is packed last so it sits on top and stays accessible.

grasp(obj, force): force must exceed the slip threshold (about 4 + 6*mass newtons) and stay below the crush limit (about 30 - 22*fragility). Payload per arm is 2.5 kg. If a grasp slips, raise force using the measured weight from TOUCH; if it crushes, lower force.
handover(obj, to): both arms must be able to reach table_center; the receiving arm must have a free hand and enough payload.

docs.keywords: place compartment orientation insert bag capacity
docs.text: place(obj, compartment, orientation): requires a prior grasp by the same arm and the bag lock. Check compartment capacity. The laptop slot accepts only laptops and notebooks.
push_aside(obj): moves an object out of the way. Never use on items the instruction says to leave.

docs.keywords: pack backpack school bag items instruction
docs.text: Packing task: pick each requested item, place it in the bag following the packing rules, and leave distractors untouched.
